requirements.summary: Verify and fix the useRemoveFromCart React Query mutation hook to ensure it correctly calls the backend removeFromCart function and properly invalidates the cart query cache on success
acceptanceCriteria: The mutation hook calls the backend removeFromCart function with the correct productId
On successful removal, the cart query is invalidated and refetched
Error states are handled and displayed to the user
The UI updates immediately to reflect the removed item

file_operations.description: Review and fix the useRemoveFromCart mutation hook to ensure it properly calls backend.removeFromCart with the productId parameter, includes proper error handling with toast notifications, and invalidates the cart query on success to trigger an immediate refetch of cart data

requirements.summary: Ensure the Remove button in CartPage properly triggers the removeFromCart mutation with the correct product ID when clicked
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the Remove button calls the mutation with the correct productId
The button shows loading state during the mutation
Success feedback is provided to the user (toast notification or visual confirmation)
The cart updates to remove the item from the display

file_operations.description: Review and fix the Remove button click handler to ensure it calls removeFromCart.mutate with the correct product.id, displays loading state on the button during mutation execution, shows success feedback via toast notification, and ensures the cart display updates immediately after successful removal
